headline: I help you (actually) use AI.
about:
Brand Partnerships / Speaking: collabs@charliehills.ai

Are you posting on LinkedIn and getting nothing back?

Tired of guessing what works while your competitors grow?

It's time to build a system that turns content into clients.

Look, here's the deal:

1) LinkedIn is the highest-ROI platform for B2B growth.
2) AI has made it possible to create a week of content in 30 minutes.

Most people are still winging it.

Posting without a plan. Writing without a system.

The ones winning on LinkedIn have both.

The question is, how do you go from ignored to in-demand?

Here's what to know. To grow on LinkedIn, you need:

✦ A profile that converts visitors into followers
✦ A content system you run weekly, not daily
✦ AI tools trained on your voice, not generic templates
✦ An engagement strategy that builds real relationships
✦ A funnel that turns followers into paying clients

This all takes time and the right systems.

So you have two options:
1) Figure it out alone through trial and error.
2) Use the exact frameworks behind 200k+ followers.

Either way, I've got you covered.

I left my 9-to-5 in September 2024. I grew from zero to 200k followers in under two years. I built multiple six-figure creator businesses with four revenue streams. I now teach thousands of marketers and creators to do the same.

Check out my Featured section below for more.

Or DM me and I'll point you in the right direction.

experience.description: Building an AI-powered infographic generator that creates fully branded, fully editable graphics in minutes. No design skills required.

I create practical AI content for marketers, founders, and creators who want to use AI properly, not just talk about it.

That includes content systems, frameworks, breakdowns, and weekly deep dives through the MarTech AI newsletter on Substack.

The newsletter now reaches 50,000+ subscribers every week.

Each issue covers one AI marketing topic in depth: tools, workflows, real examples, and what actually moves the needle.

If you want weekly AI marketing insights that are actually worth reading, subscribe below.

https://charliehills.substack.com/

When I left my 9-to-5, I didn't want to start just another ghostwriting agency.

I wanted to build something that helped founders turn ideas into influence and influence into inbound.

That's how Linked Agency started.

At first, it was just me writing posts and figuring out what worked.

Then I realised most founders didn't need more content.

They needed a strategy that connected content to conversion.

So we built a system that does exactly that.

From idea capture to distribution, everything flows through one process.

Now, a year later, we're scaling personal brands across the globe.

Not with gimmicks, but with repeatable systems.

Most LinkedIn users aren’t held back by ideas.

They’re held back because they’re building alone.

That’s why we created The AI Creators' Club.

Live breakdowns, proven AI systems, and a community that helps you grow in weeks instead of months.

We teach the workflows we use ourselves so creators can scale without burning out.

Before AI and LinkedIn, I was running kitchens.

Literally.

I co-founded Kitchen X Brands, a food tech start-up that licensed virtual restaurant brands to kitchen operators.

We started with one brand and a handful of locations.

Two years later, we'd scaled to 30+ sites across UK (all bootstrapped).

That experience shaped how I build today.

Operations, systems, brand, scale - it's the same DNA, just a different industry.

Back then we served burgers.

Now we serve content.
